lines.en: I shuffle on my mother's back.
Eight legs grip hard shell.
When she moves, I sway too.

lines.zh: 我从她的尾巴爬到头部。
lines.en: I crawl from her tail to her head.
Sand grains hit my back.
I look down. It's high.

lines.zh: 我短短的尾巴还翘不起来。
lines.en: My short tail can't lift yet.
Bobbing along as she walks.
My little pincers grip her shell seam.
I creep to the edge to look.
On her back, sand stings my face.
I ride with her across the dunes.

lines.zh: 脚下滑了一下，我又抓住。
lines.en: I slip, then grab again.
My shadow falls on her shell.
I crawl back to the steadiest spot.
Riding on her back, I sway along.
I lie in the middle of her back.
It's warm and safe here.
I groom my feelers with my pincers.
My stinger isn't ready yet.
Listening to the sand.
The shell on her back is hard.
I rise up to look around.
We're moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身体只有一点点大。
lines.en: I'm only a tiny thing.
I hide in my mother's shadow.
I tuck under one of the plates.
The desert wind comes in gusts.
I raise my pincers and still can't reach you.
I'm on my mother's back.
Don't put your hand so close.
My pincers are small, but they pinch.
Are you looking at us?
We come from the desert.
She'll protect me well.
Don't stand in her shadow.
My tail has no venom yet.
I'll just stay here and not move.
I shrank up in fright.
One of my legs went numb.
I nearly slid off her back.
I made a very small sound.
A scratch on my shell.
I'm burrowing into a seam.
It hurts, but I'm still crawling.
My pincer won't close right.
I grip and won't let go.
My pincers, they trembled.
A little sweet, a little rank.
I'm not much good at finding food.
Mother brings it back for me.
Such a small piece — for me?
I reach with my pincers. Too far.
One taste. Not bad.
Your swaying weakens my grip.
Too little, not even a mouthful.
I want a live bug.
She tastes first, then I eat.
You touched my mother.
The bump sways me; I hold tight.
I'm holding on. Don't shake.
You hit the shell on this side.
I'm small. Easy to drop.
Move over a little, please.
I've pulled into a shell seam.
Touch again and she'll move.
I swayed along with that too.
Don't poke at me with things.
I'm only a juvenile.
I have to grow big first.
Ask me again when I'm grown.
I don't even have a stinger.
When I leave my mother's back.
Too early to speak of it.
I just want to stay here.
I'm too young; don't ask me that.
I'll duck under the shell.
There are other scorpions in this desert.
I pinch it up.
So light. I can lift it.
I lift it and let go; pointless.
I drag it to the shell's edge.
My mother will notice this.
I nearly crushed it.
It moved and made me jump.
I push it over the edge.
I hide it under a plate.
My pincers can't hold it; never mind.
I see something moving.
I've raised my little pincers.
The sand over there is shifting.
That's very close to us.
I moved toward the middle.
That shadow moves; I fix on it.
My mother has raised her head.
I don't dare touch that.
It's coming toward us.
I lifted my tail a little.
I should get underneath.
I gripped her shell.
That thing is still over there.
I'm trying to stay still.
Something moves beneath the sand.
Mother is shifting forward.
I'm making myself small.
Sand is blowing and I can't see.
I hear very light footsteps.
Just wait a little longer.
She's between me and it.
I'm pressing myself lower.
I press myself flatter.
I'm hiding under a shell plate.
I pinched with my little pincers.
That barely hurt.
I bumped it and pulled back.
My tail swung once.
This is all the strength I have.
Let go. I need to grip the shell.
Sting first, then bite.
That one was wasted.
I got flicked aside.
I scrambled back quickly.
The shell splits; my first steps are soft.
The sand is still warm.

lines.zh: 我第一个动作是找母亲。
lines.en: My first move was to find my mother.
I climbed onto her back.
My shell is still soft.
The desert is huge. I'm tiny.
I climb out of the sand, still tiny.
The sand burns my feet; I scramble.
I try lifting my pincers.
I've only just learned to walk.

lines.zh: 沙地烫起来，我直往后退。
lines.en: The sand heated up and I scrambled back.

lines.zh: 我从背甲上掉进了沙里。
lines.en: I fell off her back into the sand.

lines.zh: 水把我泡住了，我动不了。
lines.en: Water soaked me and I can't move.
The blast threw all the sand up.

lines.zh: 有个尖东西擦过我的腿。
lines.en: Something sharp grazed my leg.
That light numbed my pincers.

lines.zh: 我已经好久没吃东西了。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a long while.
The flash turned the sand white.
There's no bottom; I keep falling.
